segments.he: אות א מודה במקצת הטענה ישבע. אבל כופר בכל פטור משובעה רק חז"ל תקנו היסת:
segments.he_nikud: מוֹדֶה בְּמִקְּצַת הַטַּעֲנָה - יִשָּׁבַע, אֲבָל כּוֹפֵר בַּכֹּל - פָּטוּר מִשְּׁבוּעָה, רַק חֲכָמֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָ

segments.he: עפ"י המאמר תפלחהב לחבקוק (סי' י"ט) ע"ש היטב. והנה ישראל זכו לשלימות לה"ק אשר על ידו רוממנו מכל לשון ע"ש כי עמך ישראל כולם צדיקים שהוא בחי' שמירת הברית שהוא ע"י שלימות לה"ק כ"ש שם וע"כ כופר בכל פטור מן השבועה. כי כשהוא מודה במקצת נמצא שהוא בבחי' עץ הדעת טו"ר. בחי' תרגום. שהוא מעורגב טוב ורע. כי השקר וההכחשה הוא זוהמת הנחש שהוא רע הכולל לשונות העמים פגם הברית. בבחי' ילדי שקר זרע מנאף וכו' (ישעי' נז). וע"כ העכום כולם מלאים שקר כשרז"ל אבל שארית ישראל לא יעשו עולה ולא ידברו כזב וכו' כי הם כולם זרע אמת. בחי' שומרי הברית. בחי' ועמך ישראל כולם צדייקםכנ"ל. שהוא בחי' שלימות לה"ק וע"כ אין אנו חושדין את ישראל על שקר גמור שיהיה כופר בכל שהוא רע הכולל לגמרי. וזה שארז"ל חזק אין אדם מעיז פניו בפני בעל חובו. כי העזות הוא ג"כ זוהמת הנחש רע לגמרי בחי' פגם הברית בחי' ומצח אישה זונה וכו'. וכמובא ששם עיקר החציפות והעזות. היפך הקדושה שהוא בחי' לה"ק שהוא בחי' בושת פנים בחי' יראה בושת. ובוודאי לא נחשד ישראל שישקר ויעיז פניו שהוא תוקף הזוהמא של בחי' לשונות העממין ובפריט נגד בעל חובו שעשה לו טובה. והוא יעיז נגדו ויהיה כפוי טובה שזהו בחי' פגם זוהמת הנחש שבא ע"י חטא עץ הדעת בחי' האשה אשר נתתי עמדי וארז"ל שהי' כפוי טובה: כי אז כפר בעיקר בחי' כופר בכל. אבל ישרא לשעמדו על הר סיני פסקה זוהמתן. כי זכו לשלימות לה"ק שעל ידו בחר בנו אז מכל לשון. וע"כ הם בחזקת שאינם כפוי טובה ולא יעיזו פניהם לשקר לגמרי. אבל כשהוא מודה במצקת נמצא שבקצת הוא מודה על האמת שהוא בחי' טוב. וקצת משקר שהוא הרע ונמצא שהוא בבחי' עץ הדעת טו"ר בחי' תרגום שהוא כרוך תמיד אחר בחי' לה"ק בחי' קדושת ישראל. וע"כ רמי רחמנא שבועה עלי' כי היכי דלודי. אבל זה רחוק שיפול ח"ו איש הישראלי מא יגרא רמא וכו' דהיינו מקדושת ישראל בחי' לה"ק אל הרע לגמרי דהיינו כופר בכל ר"ל. וזשארז"ל (שם) ובכולי' בעי דלודי לי' ובכולי בעי לכפרי' זה בחי' עץ הדעת שהוא מעורב טוב ורע. והוא בחי' מתקלא כמובא שם שהוא נוטה לכאן ולכאן. כי הוא סמוך אל הקדושה. ומלמטה סמוך אל הס"א כי הוא בין שניהם. וע"כ חיב שבועה כי השבועה הוא בחי' שלימות לה"ק וכמ"ש לעיל בה' שבועות שבחי' השבועה היא בחי' שמקשר הדיבור אל הקדושה ואז א,א לשנותו. בבחי' לא יחל דברו, לא יעשה דברו חולין וכ"ש שם. כי השבועה הוא בבחי' מלכות כמובא. שהיא בחי' לה"ק. וזה בחי' נשבעתי בקדשי (תהלים פט) שעיקר השבועה הוא שמחבר הדיבור אל הקדושה שזה בחי' לשון הקודש כנ"ל. וע"כ מאחר שהוא בבחי' תרגום בחי' עץ הדעת כנ"ל. ע"כ ע"י השבועה שהוא בחי' לה"ק בוודאי יודה על האמת. כי דרך התרגום לעלות אל לה"ק. דהיינו שהרע נכנע ונתבטל והטוב עולה אל לה"ק כ"ש שם:
segments.en: The matter of inheritance to the children, and the essential inheritance belongs to the male son specifically; and if he has no son, “and you shall transfer his inheritance to his daughter,” etc.

segments.he: וזה בחי' שבועה להכחיש את העד שהיא ג"כ שבועה דאורייתא כי עיקר העדות בב' שהם בחי' שלימות לה"ק בחי' פי שנים כנ"ל. שזה בחי' לה"ק בחי' ויהיו נא פי' שנים כנ"ל. שזה בחי' לה"ק בחי' ויהיו נא פי שנים בחי' שנים מקרא כנ"ל. וע"כ יש להם נאמנות שמדברים אמת. כי שלימות לה"ק היא בחי' אמת ואמונה. אבל כשהוא אחד לבד. הוא בבחי' תרגום בבחי' ואחד תרגוםץ. כי עיקר הקדושה דהינו בחי' לה"ק. הוא בבחי' שנים מקרא בחי' פי שנים כנ"ל. שזהו בחי'לשון הקודש שהלשון שהוא הדיבור מחובר אל הקודש. שהוא החכמה בחי' רוח עילאה ורוח תתאה בבחי' התחברות אמת ואמונה. שזה עיקר הקדושה ואז אין להשקר שהוא הרע שום אחיזה. אבל כשהוא אחד נפרד. ואין שני בן זוגו. אזי הוא בבחי' אחד תרגום בחי' עץ הדעת. כי כשבחי' הקדושה יורדת ונפרדת מלמעלה אזי מתלבשת למטה והם נאחזין בה. ומזה נעשה בחי' עץ הדעת שהוא מעורב טו"ר. וזה בחי' טובים השנים מן האחד (קהלת ד) כי לא טוב היות האדם לבדו. וע,כ כשהוא עד אחד. אין האמת ברור כי כשהוא אחד ואין שני יש להם אחיזה ח"ו כנ"ל. וכן מצינו שאדם אסור לצאת יחידי בלילה. אבל שנים רשאים כי כשהם שנים הם נשמרים מהם כי אין להם אחיזה בהם. בבחי' טובים השנים כנ"ל. וע"כ אין לעד אחד נאמנות לגמרי כי הוא בבחי' א' תרגום. שהוא מעורב טו"ר כנ"ל. וגם אין יכול הבע"ד להכחישו לגמרי. מאחר שהוא סמוך א להקדושה. ויש שם טוב כנ"ל וע"כ צריך לישבע כנגדו. וע"י השבועה נאמן להכחיש את העד כי השבועה היא בחי' לה"ק שהוא למעלה מן התרגום. כי השבועה הוא בחי' פי שנים. דהיינו שמקשר הדיבור אל הקדושה כנ"ל וזשארז"ל שכשכופל דבריו הוי לשון שבועה לענין שבועת ביטוי כי כפל הדברים הוא בחי' פי ש נים. בחי' שנים מקרא בחי' לה"ק שהיא בחי' שבועה כנ"ל בחי' שבע ביום הללתיך (תהלים קי"ט) היינו בחי' לה"ק שהטוא בחי' תהלות ותפילות להש"י. וע"כ ע"י השבוע שהוא בחי' לה"ק בחי' פי שנים נאמן, נגד העד שהוא בחי'אחד תרגום כנ"ל:
segments.en: And the principle that emerges for our subject is that guarding the bris [covenant] consists of two aspects: bris ilah [the upper covenant] and bris tatah [the lower covenant], which are the tzaddik and the lamdan [Torah scholar]. These are the aspect of: “the angel of Hashem of Hosts” (Malachi 2:7). “Angel” — this is the aspect of the lamdan, the aspect of Metatron, who comprises the six orders of Mishnah, the aspect of bris tatah. And the tzaddik in good deeds — this is the aspect of bris ilah, the aspect of “Hashem of Hosts — He is a sign in His host,” etc. — see there.

segments.he: ובדורות האחרונים תקנו גם לכופר הכל שבועת היסת כי בתוקף הגלות שהתגברה הס"א. דהיינו לשונות העמים בחי' השקר. מאחר שישראל גלו ביניהם על כן תקנו שבועה אפילו לכופר בכל,. כי עכשיו אפשר שיתאחז בו גם השקר לגמרי ח"ו כנ"ל דהיינו לשונות העמים כנ"ל וע"כ צריך שבועה. וע"כ קראוה שבועת היסת כי היא כנגד זוהמת הנחש שהוא השקר לגמרי והוא הנקרא מסית. וע"כ חז"ל הסיתו בו והתגרו בו ותקנו שבועה כי היכי דלודי כדי להכניעו. כי בודאי ע"י השבועה יודה כי לא נחשד על השבועה אף שהוא כופר בכל. כמשארז"ל אשתמויטי קר משתמיט וגם מחמת שמא מלוה ישינה יש לו עליו. וע' בפוסקים הדינים הללו. כי אפילו בגלות שמתגבר אפילו הרע לגמרי כנ"ל דהיינו לשונות העמים כנ"ל א,א להם להתגבר כ"א ע"י מעט הטוב שיש ביניהם. דהיינו שמראה לו היתר אפילו בהרע וגלרמי. ואף שבאמת אין זה היתר כלל. עכ"ז מאחר שתחלת פתחו לפתותו הוא עי"ז נמצא שיש שם ג"כ קצת ומעט דמעט טוב. וע"כ יש כח להכניעו. מאחר שאין התגברותו כ"א ע"י בחי' מעט טוב שיש שם וע"כ כשנתגלה האמת דהיינו בחי' הקדושה והטוב לגמרי אזי הרע נכנעא ונופל לגמרי. וע"כ אפילו הכופר בכל מאחר שאפילו גם עתה אין אנו חושדין ישראל לכפור לגמרי כ"א ע"י איזה היתר כנ,ל. וזשארז"ל שמא מלוה ישנה וכו' כי בוודאי מוכרח שיהי' שם קצת טוב כנ"ל. ע"כ ע"י השבועה שהיא בחי'לה"ק. בוודאי יודה על האמת ואזי הרע נכנע ביותר בבחי' עת אשר שלט האדץ וכו' כמובא. כי זה בעצמו שהתגבר עליו הרע והשקר כנ"ל עכשיו מודה על האמת ע"י השבועה. ומבטל דברי השקר שדבר מקודם:
segments.en: And through guarding the bris, through this one merits kisufin d’kedushah [holy yearnings] — to yearn and to long constantly for Hashem, blessed be He. And through this, one makes nefashos [souls]. For holy yearnings are exceedingly precious, for through them one makes holy souls. And through this, nekudos [vowel points] are made for the letters, in the aspect of: “points of silver” (Shir HaShirim 1:11). For the nekudos relative to the letters are in the aspect of the soul relative to the body — for the nekudos direct the letters, pair them, and combine them. For without the nekudos, the letters have no form, no movement, and no combination — just as the body has no vitality and no movement without the soul.
segments.he_nikud: וּבַדּוֹרוֹת הָאַחֲרוֹנִים תִּקְּנוּ גַּם לְכוֹפֵר הַכֹּל שְׁבוּעַת הֶסֵּת, כִּי בְּתֹקֶף הַגָּלוּת שֶׁהִתְגַּבְּרָה הַסִּטְרָא אָחֳרָא, דְּהַיְנוּ לְשׁוֹנוֹת הָעַמִּים בְּחִינַת הַשֶּׁקֶר. מֵאַחַר שֶׁיִּשְֹרָאֵל גָּלוּ בֵּינֵיהֶם, עַל כֵּן תִּקְּנוּ שְׁבוּעָה אֲפִלּוּ לְכוֹפֵר בַּכֹּל, כִּי עַכְשָׁו אֶפְשָׁר שֶׁיִּתְאַחֵז בּוֹ גַּם הַשֶּׁקֶר לְגַמְרֵי, חַס וְשָׁלוֹם, כַּנַּ"ל, דְּהַיְנוּ לְשׁוֹנוֹת הָעַמִּים כַּנַּ"ל. וְעַל כֵּן צָרִיךְ שְׁבוּעָה, וְעַל כֵּן קְרָאוּהָ שְׁבוּעַת הֶסֵּת, כִּי הִיא כְּנֶגֶד זֻהֲמַת הַנָּחָשׁ שֶׁהוּא הַשֶּׁקֶר לְגַמְרֵי וְהוּא הַנִּקְרָא מֵסִית. וְעַל כֵּן חֲכָמֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה הֵסִיתוּ בּוֹ וְהִתְגָּרוּ בּוֹ וְתִקְּנוּ שְׁבוּעָה, כִּי הֵיכִי דְּלוֹדֵי כְּדֵי לְהַכְנִיעוֹ, כִּי בְּוַדַּאי עַל יְדֵי הַשְּׁבוּעָה יוֹדֶה כִּי לֹא נֶחֱשָׁד עַל הַשְּׁבוּעָה, אַף שֶׁהוּא כּוֹפֵר בַּכֹּל. כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה, אִשְׁתְּמוּטֵי קָא מִשְׁתַּמֵּיט. וְגַם מֵחֲמַת שֶׁמָּא מִלְוֶה יְשָׁנָה יֵשׁ לוֹ עָלָיו. וְעַיֵּן בַּפּוֹסְקִים הַדִּינִים הַלָּלוּ, כִּי אֲפִלּוּ בַּגָּלוּת שֶׁמִּתְגַּבֵּר אֲפִלּוּ הָרַע לְגַמְרֵי כַּנַּ"ל, דְּהַיְנוּ לְשׁוֹנוֹת הָעַמִּים כַּנַּ"ל אִי אֶפְשָׁר לָהֶם לְהִתְגַּבֵּר כִּי אִם עַל יְדֵי מְעַט הַטּוֹב שֶׁיֵּשׁ בֵּינֵיהֶם, דְּהַיְנוּ שֶׁמַּרְאֶה לוֹ הֶתֵּר אֲפִלּוּ בְּהָרַע לְגַמְרֵי. וְאַף שֶׁבֶּאֱמֶת אֵין זֶה הֶתֵּר כְּלָל, עִם כָּל זֶה מֵאַחַר שֶׁתְּחִלַּת פִּתְחוֹ לְפַתּוֹתוֹ הוּא עַל יְדֵי זֶה. נִמְצָא, שֶׁיֵּשׁ שָׁם גַּם כֵּן קְצָת וּמְעַט דִּמְעַט טוֹב. וְעַל כֵּן יֵשׁ כֹּחַ לְהַכְנִיעוֹ, מֵאַחַר שֶׁאֵין הִתְגַּבְּרוּתוֹ כִּי אִם עַל יְדֵי בְּחִינַת מְעַט טוֹב שֶׁיֵּשׁ שָׁם. וְעַל כֵּן כְּשֶׁנִּתְגַּלֶּה הָאֱמֶת, דְּהַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת הַקְּדֻשָּׁה וְהַטּוֹב לְגַמְרֵי אֲזַי הָרַע נִכְנָע וְנוֹפֵל לְגַמְרֵי. וְעַל כֵּן אֲפִלּוּ הַכּוֹפֵר בַּכֹּל מֵאַחַר שֶׁאֲפִלּוּ גַּם עַתָּה אֵין אָנוּ חוֹשְׁדִין יִשְֹרָאֵל לִכְפֹּר לְגַמְרֵי כִּי אִם עַל יְדֵי אֵיזֶה הֶתֵּר כַּנַּ"ל. וְזֶה שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה, שֶׁמָּא מִלְוֶה יְשָׁנָה וְכוּ'. כִּי בְּוַדַּאי מֻכְרָח שֶׁיִּהְיֶה שָׁם קְצָת טוֹב כַּנַּ"ל. עַל כֵּן עַל יְדֵי הַשְּׁבוּעָה שֶׁהִיא בְּחִינַת לְשׁוֹן הַקֹּדֶשׁ, בְּוַדַּאי יוֹדֶה עַל הָאֱמֶת וַאֲזַי הָרַע נִכְנָע בְּיוֹתֵר

segments.he: אבל בוודאי כשמתברר לנו שהוא כופר בלי שום היתר. אין נותנין לו שבועה. כי הכופר בפקדון חשוד על השבועה כי הרע לגמרי דהיינו שקר גמור א"א להפוך אל הקדושה. דהיינו אל האמת. ע"י שלימות לה"ק. רק מן הסתם אנו מבקשין להפך בזכותו. ולמצוא לו היתר. בחי' קצת טוב כנ"ל. ואזי אפשר להפכו אל הקדושה דהיינו אל האמת ע"י השובעה שהיא בחי' לה"ק כנ"ל שזה בחי' לשון תרגום שעולה אל לה"ק כנ"ל שזה בחי' לשון תרגום שעולה אל לה"ק. כי עכשיו ע"י התגברות לשונות העממין על ישראל. ע"י מעט הטוב שבהם עי"ז נתהפכין לשונות העממין לבחי' תרגום. מאחר שכבשו את ישראל שהם בחי' טוב ביניהם. נמצא שהם בבחי' מעורב טו"ר בחי' תרגום. ועל ידי זה בעצמו יש לנו כח להכניעם. בבחי' לשון תרגום שמכניעין הרע שבו והטוב עולה אל הקדושה. וזה בחי' עת אשר שלט וכו' כמובא וכנ"ל. כי מחמת שהם שולטין על האדם דקדושה. עי"ז דייקא מכניעין אותם מאחר שיש טוב הרבהביניהם יש כח להתגבר ולהכניע הרע ולהוציא הטוב:
segments.en: And these souls, which are the aspect of nekudos, are made through holy yearnings — through which the letters are formed for good. And conversely, the opposite, G–d forbid — see there. And through meriting to make souls through holy yearnings, through this, all one’s eating is in the aspect of lechem hapanim [showbread/bread of the Face]. And then all the stars and constellations and all the nations of the world toil for the sake of his parnasah, etc., etc. And this is the aspect of: “My Face shall go” (Shemos 33:14). For eating and parnasah are the aspect of halichah [going], the aspect of raglayim [feet], etc. And when they ascend to the aspect of Panim [Face], through this: “And I shall give you rest.” For the table atones like the altar, etc. — see all this there well.

segments.he: וזה בחי' כמה מצות שאינם נוהגים בחוץ לארץ מדאורייתא כגון מצות התלויות בארץ ואעפי"כ חז"ל תקנו שינהגו גם בח"ל. כי ח"ל שהוא ארץ העממין בוודאי אין ראוי שינהגו בארצם מצות. כי הם רע לגמרי כנ"ל. רק מאחר שישראל שרויין ביניהם. ע"כ עי"ז נמצא עתה גם שם טוב וע"כ תקנו גם שם המצות התלויות בארץ. וכמו ששמעתי מאדמו"ר נ"י שמחמת שעכשיו יושבין ישראל אצל עכו"ם ידועים. עי"ז נחלש הרע שלהם ונכנע. הש"י ימהר גאולתינו גאולה שלימה במהרה בימינו. אוכי"ר:
segments.en: And this is the aspect of the inheritance that belongs to his children after him. For all the children that one merits to beget and to leave behind as a blessing are in the aspect of tikkun habris. For the essential tikkun habris is to multiply and to beget offspring to sustain the world, as it is written: “I am Keil Shaddai; be fruitful and multiply” (Bereishis 35:11). Keil Shaddai — this is the aspect of tikkun habris, which is called Shaddai, as is known — and its repair is the aspect of “be fruitful and multiply,” to beget children in the world.

segments.he: שמעתי מאדמו"ר שיש טקלא שנלכדו בה כמה גדולי הדור וע"כ לפעמים מתפללין כראוי כדרך הגדולים וגם עושים טובה הרבה. ואעפ"כ לפעמים להיפך ח"ו. וזה ע"י אומה ידועה שלכדה וכבשה את המדינה. והצדיק האמת הי' לו לעזר להנצל מזה. ע"י שגם מקודם הי' סמוך אל הספר. אך עכשיו מחמת שישראל הרבהיושבין אצלם. עי"ז אינו רע כ"כ כמקודם ה' שימרנו ויגאלנו מהרה אמן:
segments.en:
And these children that one begets are in the aspect of the nefashos that are made through tikkun habris, as above in the Torah mentioned above. And therefore, one must sanctify oneself greatly during marital relations — to exert oneself to detach one’s thought from physical desires, from bodily desires, and to attach one’s thought only to kisufin d’kedushah toward Hashem, blessed be He, in order to draw a holy soul to one’s children, as is explained in the Holy Zohar.

And the principle is that all souls emerge from the aspect of the bris, which is the passage through which all souls pass, as is explained in the Holy Zohar. And one who guards the bris merits to beget holy souls, for one merits kisufin d’kedushah constantly, through which holy souls are born at all times — which are the aspect of nekudos for the letters. And then certainly, also when one merits to beget actual children, one certainly draws to them a holy soul, for one is separated and distinguished from bodily desires — only one’s thought is attached to Hashem, blessed be He, in kisufin d’kedushah toward Him, blessed be He, alone.

And similarly, conversely — one who blemishes the bris, G–d forbid, and is drawn after bodily desire, G–d forbid — which is kisufin of the sitra achra — then one begets souls that are not good, G–d forbid.

And behold, in truth, regarding the holiness of the bris there are thousands and tens of thousands of levels. And certainly one must beseech Hashem, blessed be He, to merit guarding the bris in completeness — namely, to be separated and distinguished from this desire entirely, at the level of true tzaddikim, who are bound to Hashem, blessed be He, in kisufin d’kedushah constantly, as above. But nonetheless, not every person merits this, and the Holy One, blessed be He, does not come with tyranny against His creatures. And therefore, all children that one begets in a permissible manner according to the Torah — all of them are in the aspect of tikkun habris. For this is the essential tikkun habris — to beget children in the world, as above. And therefore, it is explained in the words of Rabbeinu of blessed memory that marriage is a tikkun habris, for all the marriages of Israel according to the law of our Holy Torah are all in the aspect of tikkun habris, as above.

And therefore, the inheritance is due to the children. For all the money and parnasah is drawn from the children, who are the aspect of tikkun habris, as above — as is explained there in the Torah mentioned above, that through tikkun habris, everything toils for the sake of his parnasah, etc. — see there. For through his children, who are in the aspect of tikkun habris, receiving his inheritance and the fruit of his toil — through this, a repair is drawn for the soul of the deceased. And the more righteous and upright his children are, the greater the repair for the soul of the deceased.

For the essential death is drawn from the sin of Adam HaRishon, who ate from the Eitz HaDa’as Tov VaRa [Tree of Knowledge of Good and Evil] — through which death was decreed upon the world. And the essential sin of the Eitz HaDa’as is the matter explained in the Torah mentioned above — that one needs to be both a tzaddik and a lamdan. And one who considers that being a lamdan alone is a virtue — this is the aspect of Acher [Elisha ben Avuyah], who cut the plantings, because he considered that the angel Metatron in himself is an independent authority. For in truth, Metatron in himself, without the Holy One, blessed be He, is nothing and has no authority. So too, the Torah without good deeds is nothing — for if he has not merited, it becomes a potion of death for him, as all this is explained there in the Torah mentioned above.

For one needs to include and unify the aspect of the “angel” with “Hashem of Hosts” — that bris tatah be included in bris ilah. That is, one should be both a tzaddik and a lamdan, as above. And one who is a lamdan alone and does not walk in the straight path — this is the aspect of the sin of the Eitz HaDa’as Tov VaRa. For the Eitz HaDa’as is the aspect of Metatron, as is known. This was the essential sin of Adam HaRishon — his sin was the sin of Acher, who cut the plantings, who separated the aspect of Metatron from Hashem of Hosts and denied the Essence, as is explained in the [holy] books. And therefore, death was decreed upon him, for from there the death is drawn.

For through guarding the bris — which is the aspect of “the angel of Hashem of Hosts” — through this, one makes nefashos, which are the aspect of nekudos for the letters, and the letters are formed for good. And through this, one makes a bond between body and soul — which is the aspect of life. For the essential life is when the soul is connected with the body, and this is accomplished through holy yearnings, which are the aspect of nekudos for the letters — for it is all one: body and soul, and letters and nekudos. And according to how one forms the letters of the Torah for good through holy yearnings, which are the aspect of nefashos — so too one’s soul is connected with one’s body in a strong and mighty bond, until even after one’s death, one’s body is included in one’s soul. For the tzaddikim are alive and endure forever, as our Sages of blessed memory said: “Tzaddikim in their death are called living” (Berachos 18a).

And all this is merited through guarding the bris, through which they are called tzaddikim. For through guarding the bris in completeness, they merited to repair the blemish of the Eitz HaDa’as — for they include the aspect of Metatron, the aspect of the lamdan, within Hashem of Hosts, through their righteousness and their good deeds. And then the evil is separated from the Eitz HaDa’as. And then, through meriting guarding the bris, they make nefashos and enliven and form the letters for good, which were previously like a golem [unformed mass]. And so too, their body is formed for good, for it is all one, as above. For the essential thing is to break the body and compel it to yearn constantly for Hashem, blessed be He — for “today is to do them” (Devarim 7:11). For in the World to Come, certainly everyone will yearn for Hashem, blessed be He, alone, even the nations of the world. But “one who toiled on Erev Shabbos,” etc. For the essential thing is one who merits to yearn constantly for Hashem, blessed be He, the entire time that one’s soul is bound in one’s body — that one accustoms oneself to distance one’s thought, that it should not think and contemplate, G–d forbid, desires and yearnings of this world, but only that it should yearn and long constantly for Hashem, blessed be He.

And the more one yearns and longs for Hashem, blessed be He, and makes more nefashos for the letters — so too one draws holiness and vitality to one’s body. For one’s body, which is in the aspect of letters, is formed for good through the nefashos one has made, which are the vitality of the bodies that are the aspect of letters, as above. And therefore, through the children that one begets — who are the aspect of the nefashos that emerge through tikkun habris, as above — through them is the repair for the soul of the deceased, and it is considered as if he is alive, as our Sages of blessed memory said: “Whoever leaves a son to inherit him, it is as if he did not die” (Bava Basra 116a). For through the holy nefashos that he drew during his life through tikkun habris — through this, his soul is bound with his body forever, as above. For this is the aspect of the repair of the Eitz HaDa’as, which is the blemish of the bris, as above, through which death was drawn into the world, as above.

And therefore, the children receive all his money and the fruit of his toil. For the money, which is a person’s parnasah — which is the aspect of raglayim, as above — is the aspect of the body. For the vitality of the body is through eating and drinking. And one who eats with physical desire without kisufin d’kedushah — then one does not bind one’s soul to one’s body, and then when one’s soul departs, one is truly dead, may the Merciful One spare us. But when one merits kisufin d’kedushah, through which one makes nefashos, as above — then all one’s eating is in the aspect of lechem hapanim, where the eating ascends to the aspect of Panim. This is the aspect of the body being included in the soul — and not the reverse, G–d forbid. Therefore, one’s soul is bound with one’s body forever, even after death — for tzaddikim in their death are called living, through having merited kisufin d’kedushah while still in the body, through which one’s body is included in one’s soul forever, as above.

And therefore, through the children — who are in the aspect of the nefashos that emerge through tikkun habris, as above — through their receiving his money and parnasah after his death, through this, his soul is elevated and illumination and vitality are drawn to his body in the grave. For the essential repair of the deceased is through the nefashos that are made through tikkun habris — through which the sin of the Eitz HaDa’as is repaired, and the contamination of death is repelled from the deceased, and the holiness of the nefashos that were made through tikkun habris is drawn upon him. Through these nefashos, he is called “living” even in death, in the aspect of: “Tzaddikim in their death are called living” — as above.

And the essential inheritance belongs to the male son. For we need to yearn constantly for Hashem, blessed be He, with powerful yearning and longing. And then Hashem, blessed be He, also yearns for us. And through this, a yichud is made between Knesses Yisrael and the Holy One, blessed be He, and offspring are drawn forth — holy souls. As is explained there in the Torah mentioned above, the yearnings with which we yearn for Hashem, blessed be He, are the aspect of te’uvtih d’nukva [the desire of the female], etc. And the yearnings with which holiness reciprocates and yearns for us — this is the aspect of te’uvta did’chura [the desire of the male], etc. And afterward the nefashos are joined, etc. — see there.

For this is a principle: the totality of Israel, and likewise the totality of all the worlds, are in the aspect of nukva [female/receiver] — the aspect of the recipient, relative to the Influencer and the Emanator, who is the Creator, blessed be His Name, who is the aspect of d’chura [male] relative to us. This is the aspect of the yichud accomplished through all the mitzvos — that Knesses Yisrael joins with her Beloved and is included in Him, blessed be He.

And each person must see to it that he arouses himself first to yearn and to long for Him, blessed be He — that is’arusa d’l’sata should precede is’arusa d’l’eila. And then a great chesed is drawn upon him — which is the male side, in the aspect of: “When the woman emits seed first, she bears a male” (Berachos 60a). That is, when Knesses Yisrael yearns with great longing for Him until they give birth to nefashos, then Hashem, blessed be He, yearns for them and bestows upon them the light of the great chesed — which is the aspect of the male side, as is known.

For when a person does not arouse himself on his own toward Hashem, blessed be He — then Hashem, blessed be He, yearns for him, for He, blessed be He, desires and longs that he return to Him. And then is’arusa d’l’eila precedes is’arusa d’l’sata, and then the nefashos that are born are in the aspect of the female side, the aspect of: “When the man emits seed first, she bears a female.” For the essential attribute of din, which is the aspect of the female side, is drawn from the beginning of the din of the creation of the world — whose essence was because in the beginning, at the time of the creation of the world, there was is’arusa d’l’eila without is’arusa d’l’sata, as is known and understood in the writings [of the Ari z”l].

And therefore, the essential inheritance belongs to the male son, for he is drawn from the aspect of the holy nefashos that are drawn from us to Him, blessed be He, as above — which is the essential tikkun of the nefashos, as above, from which all the parnasah and money is drawn, as above. But nonetheless, if he has no son: “And you shall transfer his inheritance to his daughter” (Bamidbar 27:8). For since in any case offspring were brought forth and a soul of Israel was drawn into the world, it is all considered as tikkun habris, from which parnasah and money come.

For the soul of the female is drawn from the aspect of is’arusa d’l’eila preceding is’arusa d’l’sata — from which is the hold of the din, which is the female side, as above. But nonetheless, it is a holy soul, since in any case one was aroused afterward and yearned for Hashem, blessed be He. The essential blemish entirely is when a person is not aroused to return to Hashem, blessed be He, and to yearn for Him, blessed be He, even when Hashem, blessed be He, arouses him and calls him through many kinds of proclamations and awakenings — and he pays no heed to this, G–d forbid. This is a complete rasha, who in his lifetime is called dead — since he has evil yearnings and is drawn after the desires of this world and is not aroused to yearn and to long for Hashem, blessed be He, even after is’arusa d’l’eila, as above.

But one who in any case is aroused after is’arusa d’l’eila — who has begun to accustom himself to holy yearnings, and to incline his thought so that it does not think evil yearnings, but rather he accustoms himself to yearn and to long and to pine constantly for Hashem, blessed be He — then he too makes holy nefashos. And even though these nefashos are in the aspect of the female side, nonetheless they are in the aspect of tikkun habris. And therefore, the inheritance is due to the daughter where there is no son. For also the soul of the daughter is drawn from tikkun habris, from which the nefashos and the holy yearnings are drawn — from which comes all the parnasah, and the money is elevated to the aspect of Panim. This is the repair of the soul of the deceased — that his body be included in his soul, so that he is considered as if he is alive, as above.

And therefore, when one has no children at all, G–d forbid, then one’s wife needs yibum or chalitzah. And then: “She shall remove his shoe from upon his foot” (Devarim 25:9). The shoe — this is Metatron, which is the aspect of the Eitz HaDa’as, from which the essential death comes. The essential repair of death is through the children, who are in the aspect of tikkun habris, as above — through which Metatron is included in Hashem of Hosts, as above. Through this, one merits to make nefashos, and the letters are included in the nekudos, the bodies in the souls. And one merits the aspect of lechem hapanim — where the aspect of raglayim is included in the aspect of Panim. All this is one and the same aspect, as is explained to those who understand in the Torah mentioned above. And through this, the Torah mentioned above is well connected, and everything is embedded and joined and connected one with the other, as above. And then the contamination of death — the blemish of the Eitz HaDa’as — is sweetened, as above.

But if one did not merit to beget souls in the world and died without children, G–d forbid — this is the aspect of the blemish of the bris. And then one’s wife must perform chalitzah of the shoe — the aspect of Metatron — from upon his foot, so that the aspect of the foot of the one performing chalitzah, where the soul of the deceased is bound, as is brought — should return and ascend to the light of the Face, the aspect of: “And she shall spit in his face” (Devarim 25:9).

And therefore the daughters of Tzelafchad argued: whichever way you look at it — if we are not considered progeny, let our mother undergo yibum. For certainly, if the daughters are not fit to inherit and to elevate his estate to the aspect of lechem hapanim — which is the repair of the deceased, as above — then certainly their mother would have needed to undergo yibum, in order to elevate the soul of the deceased through his wife, who is the aspect of raglayim, as is explained elsewhere, to the aspect of lechem hapanim. For the essential repair of death is through the feet ascending to the aspect of Panim, through which his sins are atoned, as above in the Torah mentioned above. For the body is the aspect of raglayim relative to the soul, which is the aspect of Panim. And when the raglayim — which is his estate that remains after him — ascend to the aspect of Panim, through his children who receive his inheritance — who are the nefashos that emerge through tikkun habris, from which comes the entire estate — through this, the body of the deceased is included in his soul. And this is his repair, as above.

And certainly, it all depends on the nefashos and the children that one merits to leave behind, in accordance with one’s tikkun habris and in accordance with one’s holy yearnings — through all of which one’s body is included in one’s soul and is included in the light of life forever, as above.

And this is what David HaMelech, peace be upon him, requested: “From the dead, by Your hand, Hashem… their portion is in life, and Your hidden treasure You fill their bellies; their children are satisfied, and they leave their surplus to their babes” (Tehillim 17:14). He requested to be among those dead whose portion is in life — who even after their death are called living.

And this is through: “Your hidden treasure You fill their bellies.” “Hidden” [tzafun] — this is the aspect of “circlets of gold,” etc., the aspect of the pairing and combining of the letters through the nekudos, which is from the side of the north [tzafon], the aspect of: “From the north gold comes” (Iyov 37:22), as is explained there in the Torah mentioned above. And this is: “Your hidden treasure You fill their bellies.” “Their bellies” — this is the aspect of the letters of the Torah, in the aspect of: “And Your Torah is in my innards” (Tehillim 40:9). For the letters are the lowest level of the hierarchy of ta’amim [cantillation], nekudos [vowels], tagin [crowns], and osiyos [letters]. And their essential emergence is from the navel and below, which is the aspect of raglayim. And therefore, it is explained in the words of Rabbeinu of blessed memory that speech is the aspect of raglayim.

And this is: “Your hidden treasure You fill their bellies” — that one merits to fill and to combine the letters of the Torah through one’s holy yearnings, through which one makes nefashos. And through this: “their portion is in life,” as above.

And this is: “Their children are satisfied, and they leave their surplus to their babes.” For the one depends on the other. For the children are drawn from the holy nefashos of the good yearnings, as above — on account of which the inheritance is due to the children, the aspect of: “And they leave their surplus to their babes” — for it is all one, as above.

And this is: “I, in righteousness, shall behold Your face.” “Righteousness” [tzedek] — this is the aspect of raglayim, the aspect of the letters of speech, as it is written: “Righteousness shall walk before him” (Tehillim 85:14). That is: may I merit to elevate the raglayim to the aspect of Panim — which is the essential repair of death, as above. And this is: “I, in righteousness” — the aspect of raglayim — “shall behold Your face” — to elevate them to the aspect of Panim, in the aspect of: “Walk before Me” (Bereishis 17:1), as above — see all this in the Torah mentioned above well.
